name: Fire Storm

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: up to ten connected 10-foot Cubes (one 30-foot Cube on the grid)

summary: Up to ten connected 10-foot Cubes of fire: Dex save, 7d10 Fire damage, half on a success.
text: You fill up to ten 10-foot Cubes in range with fire, arranged as you like as long as each touches another. Each creature in them makes a Dexterity save, taking 7d10 Fire damage on a failure or half on a success; unattended flammable objects ignite.
